summary: R4 flags mechanically correct + well-guarded against obvious regressions (both refused in restore, both recorded as structured fields, verify adapts). Five concerns survive adversarial review. S-MAJ-01 (warning-loudness asymmetry): --skip-required-signatures lacks the companion ACK flag + stderr pause that --no-enforce-admins requires, so a careless operator can chain --skip across all cohort adopters with zero friction. S-MAJ-02 (no estate detection): no automated scan detects adopters with skip-required-signatures: true + live required_signatures.enabled = false. Three MIN + one nit also.

findings.claim: --skip-required-signatures has no companion ACK flag and no stderr WARNING+5s pause, unlike --no-enforce-admins. Careless operator can chain --skip across 5 cohort adopters with zero friction.
findings.evidence: scripts/enable-required-check.sh:397-410 (--no-enforce-admins gate); :1196-1197 (--skip apply log() only); :1080-1081 (plan log() only)
findings.impact: 5 estate adopters could run indefinitely without commit-signing enforcement; FUP filing is documentary only.
findings.mitigation: Add --i-understand-this-defers-commit-signing-enforcement companion flag (required) + 5s stderr pause WARNING block, mirroring --no-enforce-admins. Promote FUP filing to structured log field.

findings.claim: No estate-side automated audit detects adopters with skip-required-signatures: true + live required_signatures.enabled = false. Documentary FUP only, no machine enforcement.
findings.evidence: scripts/enable-required-check.sh:1414 emits the field; no CI workflow greps it; scorecard-aggregator doesn't check branch-protection signatures
findings.impact: Adopter could run for years with signing disabled while appearing onboarded. Federation primitive signing guarantee silently absent.
findings.mitigation: TF item: weekly scorecard step querying gh api repos/<adopter>/branches/main/protection/required_signatures + flagging enabled=false adopters. OR grep over branch-protection-log.md surfacing skip-required-signatures: true entries as STATUS.md TF rows.

findings.claim: Verify FAIL message for required_signatures shared between skip-path and default-POST-failed path; diagnostic ambiguity
findings.evidence: scripts/enable-required-check.sh:1312 single message vs :1301-1302 (forward-preserve has distinct message)
findings.impact: Post-mortem debugging confusion in multi-operator adopters or when live state diverges from BEFORE capture.
findings.mitigation: Split into two branches: SKIP=1 message mentions before-state preserved + live-state divergence; SKIP=0 mentions POST + expected: true.

findings.claim: Forward mode with PRESERVE=0 silently destroys pre-existing non-canonical contexts in single PUT. No guard detecting brownfield-without-flag intent.
findings.evidence: scripts/enable-required-check.sh:1062-1069 greenfield branch no pre-context detection; verify PASSES because single-element list = expected
findings.impact: Operator forgetting flag against any of 4 remaining cohort adopters silently removes prior CI gates; PASS hides destruction.
findings.mitigation: After BEFORE_JSON capture: if PRESERVE=0 + BEFORE has contexts ≠ REQUIRED_CONTEXT, emit stderr WARNING (not refuse — greenfield re-runs legitimate). Also add CAUTION line to log block when warned.

findings.claim: Renovate bot (Mend Cloud) does not sign commits by default; closing FUP-COMMIT-SIGNING by enabling required_signatures breaks Renovate SHA-pin-bump PRs
findings.evidence: renovate/default.json no commitSigning config; Mend Renovate Cloud public behavior; ADOPT-001:886 implies simple re-run
findings.impact: Adopter closes FUP, finds Renovate broken, may disable required_signatures permanently. Operational surprise.
findings.mitigation: Add note to ADOPT-001 §12 --skip-required-signatures section about Renovate signing dependency before closure.

findings.claim: FORWARD_CAUTION_LINES_BLOCK doesn't include CAUTION entries for --no-enforce-admins or --skip-required-signatures; asymmetric with restore mode which always records CAUTION
findings.evidence: scripts/enable-required-check.sh:1016-1225 forward block populated only with GATE2 + WRAPPER_INACCESSIBLE; :1105 restore includes admin removal CAUTION
findings.impact: Committed log block lacks CAUTION marker for forward posture-degradation; symmetry gap (pre-existing, not introduced by R4).
findings.mitigation: Initialize FORWARD_CAUTION_LINES array; add admin-bypass + skip-signatures CAUTION entries when relevant.
